info.title: RSVP Celebration API
info.description: Celebration Site Service (lanes 10-15). Behind Kong at /celebrations. Errors are RFC 9457 problems. 1.1.0: optional public host contact in content.hostContact ({email?, phone? E.164, consentPublic: true}); refused without consent (422 HOST_CONTACT_CONSENT_REQUIRED) or channel (INVALID_HOST_CONTACT), null removes it, never translatable. It is public once published (GET /public/{slug}) so guests past the RSVP deadline know whom to write to. 1.2.0 (additive): GET /celebrations/admin/summary, ADMIN only, celebrations per status for the platform dashboard. 1.3.0 (additive, A18): GET /celebrations/{celebrationId}/public-page tells whether the public page agrees with the publication decision (LIVE, PUBLISHING, UNPUBLISHING, OFFLINE); clients show the celebration as published only when LIVE. 1.4.0 (additive, M10 / D-1): Celebration.searchIndexing (default false), changed with PATCH /celebrations/{celebrationId} {searchIndexing}; PublicCelebration.indexable; GET /celebrations/public lists only indexable celebrations. Clients send noindex unless indexable is true. 1.5.0 (additive, F1 de plantillas, Q5): GET /celebrations/{celebrationId}/design-reference returns the reference of the published version of the celebration's invitation design (DesignReference). The design itself lives in Template/Media; this service only stores the reference it learns from template.design.published.v1, and never goes back to an older version. 1.6.0 (additive, F7 / PL-F7): content reports and moderation. POST /celebrations/public/{slug}/reports (anonymous; closed list of reasons ReportReason, optional plain-text comment up to 1000 characters, optional element {kind,id}; 404 when the page is not live; 422 for a reason outside the list; 429 with Retry-After: 5 per IP and hour, and 200 per celebration and day). ADMIN queue: GET /celebrations/admin/reports, GET /celebrations/admin/reports/{reportId}, POST /celebrations/admin/reports/{reportId}/resolution (DISMISS, HIDE_ELEMENT, HIDE_PAGE), GET /celebrations/admin/appeals and POST /celebrations/admin/takedowns/{takedownId}/appeal-decision (ACCEPT restores, REJECT keeps it hidden). Host: GET /celebrations/{celebrationId}/moderation and POST /celebrations/{celebrationId}/takedowns/{takedownId}/appeal (one appeal per decision, the second is 409 APPEAL_ALREADY_USED). A hidden page answers 404 on GET /public/{slug} and leaves GET /public; a hidden element is removed from PublicCelebration.content and enabledSections and listed in PublicCelebration.hiddenElements. Events: celebration.moderation.content-hidden.v1 and celebration.moderation.appeal-decided.v1 (AsyncAPI 1.24.0). Review round 1 of 1.6.0 (still additive): a BLOCK or IMAGE element is addressed by the `id` or `key` of an item of a content list or by a content path `path:<a.b.0>` (path:title, path:venueName, path:venues.0, path:faq.2); a SECTION by its code. Reporting or hiding an element the published page does not have is 422 ELEMENT_NOT_FOUND. Report comments are stored literally and are plain text, never HTML: clients must escape them (422 INVALID_TEXT_CHARACTER for control or direction characters). GET /celebrations/{celebrationId}/public-page adds state HIDDEN and `moderation` (reason, guidance) while moderation hides the page. The ADMIN queues answer 400 for a limit outside 1-100 or a negative offset. IPv6 clients are limited per /64 and each celebration accepts at most 200 reports per day from anyone (429). Review round 2 (still 1.6.0, owner decisions of 2026-11-24): limits are 5 reports per IP per hour and 200 per celebration per day (they replace the round 1 limits of 3 per client and celebration, 20 per IP and 50 per celebration per hour). POST /celebrations/admin/takedowns/{takedownId}/restoration lifts a hiding directly, with or without an appeal (audited CONTENT_RESTORED, event celebration.moderation.content-restored.v1); one appeal per decision is unchanged (the second is 409 APPEAL_ALREADY_USED, also after a rejection). Deciding an appeal twice at once gives 200 and 409 NO_PENDING_APPEAL. A list item is hidden by its id/key or by `hash:<sha256>` of its value, never by position (see ElementRef). The moderation audit of a deleted celebration is kept for one year without actor, reason or details, and then purged (no contract change).

state.description: LIVE: published and the page exists. PUBLISHING: published, page not built yet. UNPUBLISHING: withdrawn, page still served. OFFLINE: not published and no page. HIDDEN (F7): published, but moderation hides the whole page (guests get 404); see `moderation`.

publicVersion.description: Celebration version the public page was built from; null without page

guidance.description: How to fix it, written by the moderator.

moderation.description: The active decision that hides the whole page, or null. It stays reported while the page is unpublished, because republishing does not lift it. The host appeals it with POST /celebrations/{celebrationId}/takedowns/{takedownId}/appeal.

content.description: Free content keyed by field. `eventDate` and keys ending in `At` are instants: send an offset (stored as is) or a wall clock YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm (read in the celebration timeZone). Optional `hostContact` {email?, phone? (E.164), consentPublic: true} is validated; see info.description (1.1.0).

indexable.description: D-1: true only when the host allowed indexing; otherwise clients must send noindex.

hiddenElements.description: F7: elements moderation hid. They are already removed from content and enabledSections; empty almost always.

version.description: Latest published version of that design

ReportReason.description: Closed list. SEXUAL_CONTENT, VIOLENCE_OR_HATE, SCAM_OR_IMPERSONATION, COPYRIGHT, PERSONAL_DATA, SPAM; OTHER requires a comment.

id.description: SECTION: the section code, one of enabledSections. BLOCK or IMAGE: either the `id` or `key` of an item inside a list of `content` (for example a schedule item `s1` or the venue `ceremony`), or a content path with the prefix `path:` and dot-separated segments, where a list index counts from 0: `path:title`, `path:venueName`, `path:hosts.BRIDE`, `path:venues.0`, `path:faq.2`. A path refers to the published document at the moment of hiding. Files served by Template/Media (photos, backgrounds, logos, own music) are not part of the content, so a file id is not an element: it is answered 422 ELEMENT_NOT_FOUND. To hide gallery photos report the `gallery` SECTION; Template/Media consumes the moderation events (content-hidden, content-restored, appeal-decided) and stops serving them by every route, and hiding the whole page (scope PAGE) stops serving every file of the celebration. The element must exist on the published page or the request is 422 ELEMENT_NOT_FOUND. PL-142-R15: a list position is never what is stored. When an administrator hides a list item addressed by a path ending in an index (`path:venues.0`), the stored Takedown.element.id is the item's own `id` or `key`, or, if it has neither, `hash:<64 hex>` = SHA-256 of the item's canonical JSON (keys sorted); both follow the item wherever the host moves it, so inserting an item at the front neither brings the offending one back nor hides an innocent one. `hash:<64 hex>` is also accepted as input for BLOCK and IMAGE.

comment.description: Plain text, stored exactly as sent (nothing is stripped): it is never HTML and every client that shows it, the admin queue first, must escape it. Control and direction characters are refused (422 INVALID_TEXT_CHARACTER); whitespace only counts as no comment.

reporterRef.description: First 12 hex characters of the salted HMAC of the reporter address: lets a moderator see repeat reporters without storing or showing the address.

note.description: Internal note; kept in the audit log.

guidance.description: How the host can fix it; sent to the host in celebration.moderation.content-hidden.v1.

element.description: HIDE_ELEMENT only; defaults to the element the report points at (422 ELEMENT_REQUIRED when neither exists). It must exist on the published page (422 ELEMENT_NOT_FOUND): nothing is hidden, audited or notified otherwise.

note.description: Shown to the host in the notice; stays in the audit.
